_comment: Every setting of the experiment, written before the first retrieval run. Token counts are Llama 3.2 tokens (the answer model's), counted by tokens.py / tokens.js. 'budgets' are context sizes: retrieved chunks are added in rank order, a chunk that doesn't fit the remaining budget is skipped, and the next one is tried. Selection rule, fixed before the run: rank strategies by how many development questions have their evidence found at the primary budget; break ties by fewer indexed tokens. The answer stage runs the baseline plus the two best-ranked other strategies on the test questions.
